name: IGL Spirits Limited
remarksWeb: 1.(a).Voting rights of 9,35,661 Equity Shares of Rs.5/- each lying in the name of IEPF Authority, shall remain frozen in terms of Rule 6 of Investor Education & Protection Fund (Account, Audit, Transfer and Refund) Rules, 2016 as amended.       (b) The voting rights attached to 6,03,388 equity shares of Rs. 5/- each, comprising shares held by physical shareholders and shares arising from corporate actions rejected by the Depositories, have been credited to a Suspense Account and shall remain frozen in accordance with the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.      2. (a). Pursuant to the provisions of regulation 31(4) M/s Kashipur Holding Limited is the promoter of the Company whereas all other Individuals/Body corporates are falling under the Category of Promoter Group.      (b). Ajay Commercial Company Private Limited, Facit Commosales Private Limited, JB Commercial Company Private Limited, J. Boseck & Co. Private Limited and Lund & Blockley Private Limited were part of Promoter Group of Demerged Company i.e. India Glycols Limited on Record Date.      3. Details for SBO are disclosed under the Companies (Significant Beneficial Owners) Rules, 2018. Shri Uma Shankar Bhartia, Smt. Jayshree Bhartia, Smt. Pooja Jhaver and Smt. Pragya Bhartia Barwale Individually and collectively, hold less than 10% shareholding in the Company. Collectively for all the persons acting together, the same is 2.50% i.e. aggregate of the (i) direct shareholding i.e. 2.31% [held individually by  Shri Uma Shankr Bhartia- 1.34%, Smt. Jayshree Bhartia- 0.68%, Smt. Pooja Jhaver- 0.29% and Smt. Pragya Bhartia Barwale-0.00% (600 shares)and as persons acting together] and (ii) indirect shareholding i.e. 0.19% held by M/s. Hindustan Wires Ltd. Further, Shri Uma Shankar Bhartia exercises significant influence.
